Candidates must enter his/her Question Booklet Serial No. (10 Digits) in the OMR Answer Sheet. 2. Candidates are required to give their answers in their own words as far as practicable. 3. Figures in the right hand margin indicate full marks.

notes: Exam cover page confirms SCIENCE, Subject Code 112, Secondary School Examination 2024 (Annual) — correct subject, no F8-style mismatch (checked page 1 first per F8 lesson).

Footer says 'Page 1 of 40' — this cover page IS printed page 1 (unlike 2024-a, where the cover was footer-labelled 'Page 4 of 40'). PDF has 39 pages vs declared 40 — gap of exactly 1, to be watched for as pages are read.
Different Subject Code (112, Set Code I) and Question Booklet Serial prefix from 2024-a (212, Set Code G) — confirms this is a genuinely different paper/shift, not a duplicate.
